title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Bitcoin whale that sat through the March 2020 crash moves $378 million
description: A bitcoin whale that received coins days before the Covid crash and sat through it has moved millions on-chain.

title: Blur is shutting down its website, so why are NFT collectors cheering?
description: Blur’s planned website closure revived criticism of the royalty policies and token rewards that helped it overtake OpenSea during the NFT boom, but hurt creators.

title: Tokenized SanDisk bets saw more liquidations than XRP as Asia’s chip rout wipes out $800 million
description: About $800 million in leveraged positions were wiped out over 24 hours, 86% of them bullish. Chip-stock contracts on crypto exchanges took a chunk of the damage.

title: Binance to shut down crypto mining pool services in November
description: Binance will discontinue its mining pool and related services on Nov. 10, urging miners to move to alternative pools before the shutdown.

title: Once-largest Ethereum NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down after volumes collapse 99%
description: Blur will close its website on Nov. 12 after monthly trading fell from about $1.43 billion at its 2023 peak to under $7 million, ten days after sister project Blast announced its own shutdown.

title: Bitcoin rebounds above $83,000 as it decouples from tumbling Korean stocks and Nasdaq futures
description: Bitcoin climbed back above $83,000 after an early dip, decoupling from a sharp slide in Korean chip stocks and weakness in Nasdaq futures ahead of Thursday’s US CPI report.

title: South Korea moves to block 27 crypto websites, including KuCoin, MEXC
description: Authorities said the restrictions are aimed at unregistered exchanges and have acknowledged that customers could have difficulty withdrawing assets.

title: Meta claims new Muse Wonder AI models rival OpenAI, Anthropic
description: Meta co-founder Mark Zuckerberg said its newest models are a step toward “personal superintelligence.”

title: Aptos rolls out Encrypted Mempool to curb frontrunning, sandwich attacks
description: The optional feature hides transaction details until their order is finalized, preventing bots from exploiting pending trades.

title: AI Will Hit 40% of Jobs, IMF Warns. Young People Are First in Line
description: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva says AI investment is holding global growth near 3%, with Asian chipmakers winning big, while warning of a 'slow-moving tsunami' for young workers.

title: Standard Chartered Will Hold Ripple's Stablecoin in Dubai—And Let Clients Trade With It Without Moving It
description: The bank's Dubai branch now offers custody for Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin and plans a link with LMAX that lets institutions post it as trading collateral while the coins stay put.

title: FTX’s crypto mining venture is now used to advance AI
description: The defunct exchange acquired a 20% stake in Genesis Digital Assets before FTX declared bankruptcy in November 2022.

title: Meta's New Muse Wonder Finally Puts Zuckerberg in the Frontier AI Race
description: Meta's new flagship beats GPT-6 Astra and Claude on memory, legal and marathon coding tests, but independent rankings still put Anthropic's Opus 5.5 on top.

title: From GTA V on iPhone to Free Photoshop: This AI Tool Is Upending Software
description: REA, a free toolkit that hands AI agents the keys to reverse engineering, crossed 100,000 GitHub stars in a week as AI-decompiled game mods, console ports, and Adobe clones flood the internet.

title: Solana Treasury Firm DeFi Development Keeps Buying SOL as CHAD Preferred Stock Hits Record
description: The Nasdaq-listed company now holds about 2.59 million SOL, but its weekly purchases keep shrinking.

title: Crypto PACs report $2.7M spending blitz on House races as midterms loom
description: With just 22 days until the US midterm elections, a crypto-aligned committee has announced another major ad expenditure to support “pro-crypto” candidates in 2026.

title: US accounting overhaul could make stablecoins more attractive to corporations: Tempo
description: A Tempo report examines how proposed US accounting rules could change corporate stablecoin holdings, with direct redemption rights determining which tokens qualify as cash.

title: Ripple-Backed Evernorth Hits Nasdaq Holding 473 Million XRP Worth Far Less Than It Paid
description: Evernorth's XRPN shares began trading Monday after its SPAC merger closed, but 80% of SPAC investors cashed out first and its XRP stash is worth roughly 40% less than at signing.

title: Bitcoin miners face widening AI financing costs as lenders scrutinize deals
description: The Bitcoin mining industry needs roughly $50 billion to complete planned AI infrastructure projects, with IREN, Riot Platforms and HIVE Digital facing major funding gaps.

title: Bitcoin Spooked? Crypto Fear and Greed Index Drops to Pre-Rally August Lows
description: The Crypto Fear and Greed Index has dropped to 56 from an August peak of 82, as oil, bond yields, and ETF outflows hit Bitcoin in October.

title: Ledger Says All Confirmed Cases in Suspected $87M Drain Tied to Reseller CryptoBilis
description: The wallet manufacturer said its own systems and direct sales are unaffected, and that the reseller has stopped selling hardware wallets.

title: Bitcoin drops 2.2% as Ukraine, Iran strikes send oil toward one-month high
description: Bitcoin price action stayed rangebound after failing to sustain above $84,000 into the Wall Street open on rising oil prices.

title: Palantir's Europe head warns the region is 'missing the boat' on AI just as it did with the internet
description: The Palantir UK chief said the U.S. is racing ahead on enterprise AI while Europe hesitates, and explained why he thinks the company faces intense political attacks.

title: NEXTPredict Paid $12,000 to Hedge Its Conference on a Prediction Market
description: Where event insurance deals with scrapped shows and what happens inside the venue, NEXTPredict is focusing on flight cancellations.

title: XRP Ledger’s Payment Engine Had a Counterfeiting Bug Hiding Since 2015
description: An integer overflow in the payment engine, dormant since 2015, could have let an attacker mint spendable XRP beyond the token’s total supply.

title: Tom Lee sees $2 trillion wealth transfer fueling crypto demand as Bitmine buys more ether
description: The Bitmine chairman said he expects younger investors to drive demand for digital assets as his ether treasury company inches closer to owning 5% of the total supply.

title: Tokenized catastrophe bonds target the disaster-insurance gap
description: A planned Bermuda issuance would put legal ownership onchain and seek capital for disaster risks that remain costly to insure.

title: XRP treasury Evernorth’s shares rise 5% at Nasdaq opening print
description: Evernorth’s share price rose by 5% as investors welcomed the Nasdaq debut of the first pure-play XRP digital asset treasury.

title: Ledger implant tests Bitcoin ETFs as safer custodial solutions than hardware wallets
description: The discovery of an unauthorized Ledger hardware implant reignited debate on whether Bitcoin ETFs are safer than self-custodying Bitcoin via hardware wallet devices.

title: Bitmine Adds $32M in Ethereum as Tom Lee Says Firm Is Nearly 'Done Stacking'
description: The Ethereum treasury firm now holds 6.03 million ETH, 4.9% of supply, as Lee predicts the biggest crypto bull market yet.

title: Strategy Scoops Up $21.5M in Bitcoin, Buys Back $192M in STRC
description: The purchase lifts Strategy's holdings to 848,250 BTC and follows a $176 million repurchase of STRC preferred stock the week before.

title: Strategy adds 250 Bitcoin as holdings reach 848,250 BTC
description: Michael Saylor’s Strategy said Bitcoin holdings reached 848,250 BTC after its latest purchase, while maintaining a $4.88 billion cash reserve.

title: Standard Chartered offers RLUSD custody in Dubai and plans LMAX collateral link
description: Ripple previously gave LMAX $150 million in financing to integrate RLUSD into its institutional infrastructure.

title: Ledger claims CryptoBilis cases are limited as up to $93 million is traced, $10 million frozen
description: Ledger said every confirmed case involves devices sold by the Southeast Asian reseller, but critics say the hardware-wallet maker must answer for an authorized sales channel.

title: Australia proposes leverage caps for crypto-settled derivatives
description: ASIC’s proposal would extend leverage limits and protections against negative balances to certain derivatives settled in digital assets.

title: Bitcoin Ranges Near $83K as Traders Look to US Inflation Data
description: October rate-hike odds have slumped, but analysts say Treasury yields at two-decade highs are still keeping a lid on risk appetite.

title: Bitcoin falls below $83,000 as dollar strength keeps markets on edge
description: Bitcoin and gold hold steady as a firm dollar and rising bond yields weigh on sentiment, while IREN secures a multiyear cloud services deal with Anthropic.

title: BTC price support holds ahead of US CPI data: Three things Bitcoin traders need to know this week
description: Bitcoin traders braced for inflation-based volatility after BTC price action preserved key weekly support around $82,500.

title: Global financial watchdog calls for cross-border information sharing, planning for stablecoin crisis
description: Coins jointly issued by multiple companies can trap reserves in one jurisdiction while redemption demands hit another, complicating cross-border crisis response.

title: South Korea just got its first traditional bank loans backed by bitcoin
description: Loans use third-party custodians for bitcoin holdings and rely on court-ordered sales if borrowers default.

title: SWI raises $894 million to repurpose former FTX bitcoin miner Genesis Digital to AI
description: SWI Group said it would use the proceeds from an 800 million-euro ($894 million) fundraise to transform Genesis Digital Assets, acquired from the FTX bankruptcy, from a bitcoin miner to an AI-focused data center.

title: Altcoins rally on thin trading as bitcoin holds below $83,500
description: The CoinDesk 80 has risen around 3% in 24 hours, more than double the CoinDesk 5, while spot bitcoin ETFs lost $681 million last week.

title: UK Freezes $12M London Penthouse of Alleged Prince Group Finance Chief
description: Thet Li is accused of running the finances of a scam empire tied to $14 billion in Bitcoin the U.S. has moved to seize.

title: Kraken parent clears Dubai’s final hurdle for dirham trading rollout
description: Payward received full market approval from Dubai’s VARA to expand its digital asset services in the UAE, building on the preliminary approval received in May.

title: Standard Chartered adds Ripple USD custody, eyes LMAX collateral deal
description: Standard Chartered has launched custody for Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin on the XRP Ledger and plans to let institutions use the tokens as trading collateral.

title: U.S. inflation, Ethereum upgrade talks: Crypto Week Ahead
description: Your look at what's coming in the week starting Oct. 12.

title: South Korean bank launches Bitcoin-backed business loans: Report
description: Jeonbuk Bank reportedly began offering Bitcoin-backed loans to corporate customers, with a third-party custodian holding the cryptocurrency used as collateral.

title: Why a bug that could have threatened XRP's 100 billion supply cap stayed hidden for years
description: The XRP Ledger Foundation said normal parameters never triggered the bug that could have broken XRP's supply cap, which is why it was undetected for years.

title: Ledger says unauthorized implant found in at least one device sold by CryptoBilis
description: Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in a device linked to crypto losses at CryptoBilis, a Southeast Asian reseller. The company says confirmed cases are limited and its internal systems remain unaffected.

title: Global watchdog flags stablecoin risks, AI threats ahead of G20
description: The Financial Stability Board flagged cross-border stablecoin risks and AI-related cybersecurity threats while urging G20 policymakers to support stronger safeguards.

title: DATA Network to migrate to Sui, retire own chain
description: The migration is backed by a $30 million investment from Sui Foundation.

title: Bitcoin pulls back from $84,000 as oil recovers, ETFs bleed over $600 million
description: Bitcoin reversed early gains as oil bounced back to over $92. Analysts express concerns over large outflows from spot ETFs last week.

title: French lawmakers back reporting rule for crypto wallets over $112K
description: Holders could face fines of up to 10,000 euros for failing to declare qualifying assets.

title: XRP Ledger defends emergency patch for unlimited XRP bug
description: The XRP Ledger Foundation pushed back against claims that its emergency security patch was forced on network operators.

title: Ledger attack spreads to EU, AI finds ’18 trillion XRP’ bug: Hodler’s Digest
description: A user reports buying a tampered Ledger from a big retailer in Europe. Security researchers use AI to uncover a “$94 billion” XRP bug — but receive just a $250K bounty.

title: Everyone wants SCOTUS to take up prediction markets: State of Crypto
description: The U.S. Supreme Court hasn't yet indicated whether it will take up cases surrounding prediction markets, but there are now several amicus briefs, an interim final rule and a rule proposal.

title: Tokenized Stocks Show Real Demand But Remain Volatile and Illiquid, IMF Finds
description: An IMF analysis found that more than half of tokenized stock trading happens outside U.S. market hours, though the roughly $2.3 billion market remains more volatile and less liquid than traditional equities.

title: Saylor teases Strategy Bitcoin buying after ending September with STRC buybacks
description: Investors will have to wait an extra day to find out if and how much Strategy added to its Bitcoin treasury in the first week of October.

title: Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana ETFs All in the Red for October
description: Bitcoin ETFs have seen $386.3 million in net outflows through the first seven trading days of October, while Ethereum funds have now posted nine straight days of losses.
